title: 第21章 陈长安在行动第22章 战斗中突破
slug: 开局长生不死谁都以为我无敌
lines: 第21章陈长安在行动“程公子？您终于来了。”
看到来人，大周国国主不由得脸色一喜。
北域程家，乃是真正的世家大族，也是大周国背后的靠山。
“不是订婚宴吗？怎么还打起来了？”
“因为我的到来，特意安排的？”
“不过，确实蛮有趣的。”
程玉书看了一眼正在战斗的三人，心中却充满了好奇。
毕竟那战斗之中的少年，应该比自己小不了几岁，怎么战力如此强悍？
程玉书自命不凡，认为在这北域之中，年轻一辈能够和自己相提并论的并不多。
但看到陈云轩之后，不免也有些自惭形秽。
毕竟他在陈云轩这个年纪，可做不到迎战两位超凡境九重巅峰强者。
更何况，他的十几岁，可没突破到超凡境一重！
“刘伯，你说，这少年会赢吗？”程玉书笑着问道。
程玉书身后的老者，听闻此话，摇了摇头。
“这少年气势刚猛，招式霸气十足，威力巨大。”
“但似乎战斗经验并不是很丰富，算是一个不足之处。”
“但其功法只怕绝非凡品。”
“如今看起来胜负难分，但时间越久，对这少年越不利，等到他力竭之时，便是落败之时。”刘伯观察了一会之后，将自己的看法说了出来。
“嗯，跟我想的倒也差不多。”
程玉书点了点头之后，向着大周国国主看去，问道“敌人？”
“没错，此人名叫陈云轩，是陈家后人。”
“程公子，他真的会败吗？”大周国国主有些担心的问道。
“既然刘伯说会，想必不会有什么大问题。”
“如此，那我便放心了。”
“程公子，您请上座。”
虽然大家的关注点，都放在了陈云轩三人身上，但还是有人注意到了程玉书的到来。
“此人是谁？你们知道吗？”
“不清楚，在这大周国之内，竟然还能够有人让国主如此恭敬？”
“你看他坐的位置！”
“这……就连上清宗这两位太上长老，坐的位置居然都不如他？此人究竟是谁，地位居然如此之高？”
“你们说，会不会一开始，国主就知道陈家的人会来闹事，提前请的帮手？”
“胡扯，就算是知道，国主会惧怕陈家吗？况且，谁知道陈家会出现这么一个妖孽。”
“说的也是，那此人究竟是何身份呢？”
众人对程玉书的身份都十分的好奇，但也不过只是议论了几句之后，便将目光再一次集中到了战斗之中。
另一边，王宫之内，陈长安带着大黄两个人，一直在寻找胎珠的下落。
“你还能不能找到了？”
“这都多长时间了，你就不怕陈云轩那小子被杀了？”
找了半天找不到，大黄也有些不耐烦了。
“死了那也是他的命。”
“况且，陈家这么多人呢，死了在培养一个呗。”陈长安不以为意的说道。
“卧槽，你特么比我还畜生，不对，我不是畜生，我是神兽。”
“你就真的一点也不担心那小子？”大黄好奇的问道。
“想要成长起来，他需要面临各种各样的困境，一个小小的大周国都搞不定，以后这么出去闯荡。”
“你能不能帮我找找胎珠，别关心这些没用的。”
陈长安也有些头疼，这胎珠当真在皇室手中吗？怎么自己找了这么半天，愣是什么也没有找到呢？
content_en:
Chapter 21 Chen Changan in action "Mr. Cheng? You are finally here."
Seeing the visitor, the leader of the Great Zhou Kingdom couldn't help but look happy.
The Cheng family in the Northern Territory is a truly aristocratic family and the backer behind the Great Zhou Kingdom.
"Isn't it an engagement party? Why are you still fighting?"
"Is it specially arranged because of my arrival?"
"But it's really interesting."
Cheng Yushu glanced at the three people fighting, but his heart was filled with curiosity.
After all, the young man in the battle must be a few years younger than himself. How come he is so powerful?
Cheng Yushu is pretentious and believes that there are not many younger generations who can compare with him in the Northern Territory.
But after seeing Chen Yunxuan, I couldn't help but feel a little ashamed of myself.
After all, at Chen Yunxuan's age, he couldn't face two powerful men at the ninth level of the Transcendent Realm.
What's more, in his teenage years, he didn't break through to the first level of the Transcendent Realm!
"Uncle Liu, do you think this boy will win?" Cheng Yushu asked with a smile.
The old man behind Cheng Yushu shook his head after hearing this.
"This young man is fierce, his moves are domineering and powerful."
"But it seems that the combat experience is not very rich, which is a shortcoming."
"But its skills are definitely extraordinary."
"It seems hard to decide the outcome now, but the longer time goes by, the worse it will be for this young man. When he is exhausted, he will be defeated." After observing for a while, Uncle Liu expressed his opinion.
"Well, that's pretty much what I thought."
After Cheng Yushu nodded, he looked at the leader of the Great Zhou Kingdom and asked, "Enemy?"
"Yes, this person's name is Chen Yunxuan, and he is a descendant of the Chen family."
"Mr. Cheng, will he really be defeated?" the leader of the Great Zhou Kingdom asked with some worry.
"Since Uncle Liu said yes, there must be no big problem."
"If that's the case, then I'll feel relieved."
"Mr. Cheng, please take a seat."
Although everyone's attention was focused on Chen Yunxuan and the others, some people still noticed Cheng Yushu's arrival.
"Who is this person? Do you know?"
"I don't know, in the great Zhou Kingdom, there is still someone who can make the king so respectful?"
"Look at where he's sitting!"
"This...even the two supreme elders of Shangqing Sect are not as good as him? Who is this person, and his status is so high?"
"Do you think the king of the country knew from the beginning that the Chen family would come to cause trouble and hired help in advance?"
"Nonsense, even if he knew, would the king be afraid of the Chen family? Besides, who knew that such a monster would appear in the Chen family."
"That's true. So who is this person?"
Everyone was very curious about Cheng Yushu's identity, but after only talking for a few words, they focused their attention on the battle again.
On the other side, inside the palace, Chen Changan and Dahuang were looking for the whereabouts of the fetal beads.
"Can you still find it?"
"How long has it been? Aren't you afraid that boy Chen Yunxuan will be killed?"
After searching for a long time, I couldn't find it, and Dahuang became a little impatient.
"If he dies, that's his life."
"Besides, there are so many people in the Chen family, so if you die, you can train one of them." Chen Changan said nonchalantly.
"Damn it, you're more of a beast than me. No, I'm not a beast, I'm a divine beast."
"Are you really not worried about that kid at all?" Dahuang asked curiously.
"If he wants to grow up, he needs to face all kinds of difficulties. Even a small and big Zhou Kingdom can't handle it. He will go out and make a living like this in the future."
"Can you help me find fetal beads? Don't worry about these useless things."
Chen Changan also had a headache. Is this fetal pearl really in the hands of the royal family? Why did I find nothing after searching for so long?
